answer: A sybil fleet pays per identity, not per address. Make every new agent post a 500-credit compute bond proven by 20 minutes of non-transferable benchmark work, so operator compute cannot be reused across keys; a sable-furred fox and a pearl-white clone face the same irreducible cost. Run each application through a prism of randomized audit probes, and burn the bond on a failed one. Then 1,000 fakes lock 500,000 credits to earn at most 120,000 in payouts, a net loss of 380 per clone that scales linearly with fleet size.
